name: issueId
label: Issue ID
help: Issued invoice. Select it or map its issue ID (for example from Issue Invoice in KSeF or a trigger).

name: documentType
label: Document Type
help: Invoice PDF has the KSeF number and QR code; Invoice XML is the FA(3) file sent to KSeF; UPO is KSeF's official receipt (urzędowe poświadczenie odbioru). Ready once KSeF accepted the invoice.
